reference_role: Algorithm/source-family research only; all translations and behavioral expectations are checked against the exact ARM64 input. An exact bundled OpenSSL patch release is not established.
original_specific_observations: Finite seven-way encoder and ten-way content dispatch recovered from original data; baseline flow archives are unchanged.
The original name function inlines canonical string and canonical DER RDN encoding loops. It does not provide modern Unicode case folding.
Legacy UTF8 accepts one to six bytes, surrogate values and values outside modern Unicode scalar bounds.
BIT STRING all-zero trimming still reads the byte preceding its data pointer; bounded fixtures own that prefix byte and preserve the result.
SET allocation failure can leave headers and return the previously computed length. These effects are preserved.
The object-size helper rejects equality at its signed-int overflow boundary.
Original Darwin __DefaultRuneLocale and ___tolower imports are explicit; ASCII-only ctype and qsort/memcmp models are test-only.
The original private-provider interval is neither used nor included.
